question: Which of the following is also known as the 'tree frog'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hyla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Hyla** is a genus of frogs in the Hylidae family, commonly referred to as tree frogs.
 
• These frogs are known for their ability to climb trees and other vertical surfaces using their adhesive toe pads.
 
• Tree frogs (Hyla) are often small in size and are found in a variety of habitats including forests, marshes, and swamps.
 
• They are known for their distinctive calls, which are often used to attract mates during the breeding season.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rana tigrina**

 
 
• Commonly known as the Indian Bullfrog.
 
• It is a large species of frog found in India, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Nepal, Myanmar, Afghanistan, and Sri Lanka.
 
• They are not tree frogs and usually found near water bodies.
 
 
 
• **Salamandar**
 
 
• Salamanders are amphibians, typically characterized by their slender bodies, short noses, and long tails.
 
• They are not frogs and belong to a different order of amphibians called Caudata.
 
• Salamanders are found in a variety of habitats including aquatic, terrestrial, and arboreal environments.
 
 
 
• **Toad**
 
 
• Toads are amphibians of the order Anura, typically characterized by dry, warty skin.
 
• They are closely related to frogs but usually have shorter legs and are more adapted to drier environments.
 
• Unlike tree frogs, toads do not have the ability to climb trees.
